meta.purpose: decisive A/B forward diagnostic for docunetL seed2

A_side_training_forward.rule: DocREModel.forward -> ATLoss.get_label(logits, num_labels=4): threshold = ZERO (logit > 0) + top-4 mask; NA column set only when no positive
A_side_training_forward.note: training-time dev evaluation used exactly this rule (dev F1 0.4489)

B_side_registered_pipeline.rule: atlop_native decode: logit > NA_logit(col 0) AND top-4
B_side_registered_pipeline.observation: max logit == max NA logit in every doc (NA-dominant calibration)

verdict: the two forwards/decodes are NOT equivalent: ATLoss trains with a zero threshold and never calibrates relation-vs-NA ordering, so a seed that drifts NA-heavy is unreadable under the shared ATLOP-style native decode while fully functional under its own training decode. Mechanism is decode-contract family incompatibility, not seed degeneracy.
consequence: seed2 arms undefined under the registered decode; disclosed in the paper; r42 zero arms retained as evidence

eval_split_direct_measurement.s20260918: relation-column logits > 0: 0 of 18,386,932 (189,556 x 96); max relation logit = -2.48; NA column positive for 189,540/189,556 candidates

followup_20261014.decision: no retraining: even a rescued s2 is 17 F1 points below s1 and cannot strengthen pooling; current disclosure (A7 single-seed + NA-dominance mechanism) stands; attempt recorded for reviewer response
